title: Credential compromise of l.ortiz with server-room access and bulk profile export
example_questions: Investigate the authentication failures around 02:00 on 2026-09-30.
Was there any suspicious access to Building A between 00:00 and 06:00 on 2026-09-30?
Why did camera CAM-A-SERVERROOM-01 go offline at 02:15 on 2026-09-30?
Is anything unusual about l.ortiz's activity on 2026-09-30?

timeline.what: 6 failed logins for l.ortiz from external IP 203.0.113.45 using a script user agent
Successful login, same IP, no MFA
l.ortiz badge granted into A-ServerRoom via group legacy-all-access; no lobby entry first
140 global profile exports from 203.0.113.45 (portal-api logs), rate-limit warning

facts: Six failed logins then one success for l.ortiz from 203.0.113.45 within 16 minutes
The server-room access was granted only because of the legacy-all-access group; Finance is not permitted there
140 profile exports in about 7 minutes, versus 3 during her entire working day
inferences: The l.ortiz password was likely guessed or stolen (inference: the failures-then-success pattern does not prove it)
Remote login and physical badge use at the same time suggest a cloned or stolen badge, or an accomplice on site
The camera outage may be deliberate, but nothing in the data shows tampering
missing_evidence: No identity verification for the person who used the badge
No record of where the exported profiles were sent
recommended_actions: Disable the l.ortiz credential and badge BDG-1001 (requires human approval)
Assess the profile export as a possible personal-data breach

decoys.why_benign: a.khan: 3 typos from her usual internal IP, then MFA login at 10:32
CAM-B-WAREHOUSE-01 drops off and recovers all day: a flaky device, not an attack
DOOR-B-LAB-01 offline for scheduled maintenance CHG-2231
Night-shift security (s.otieno, r.haddad) badge activity after hours is normal. s.otieno was in the server room at 02:08: a possible witness, not a suspect
unknown_user failures from 198.51.100.0/24 are background internet noise
